description: Change one stop of a FareDice trip and re-chain the rest: night_more or night_less there (the flights after it move a day), night_from_next or night_to_next (a night moved from or to the next stop; the trip's end holds), add_stop (a place after it, with city; without city, the places that fit, each with its change and link) or drop_stop (the stop left out). Returns the new trip as get_trip does, with how much the flights change and how far the end moves. Without change, every change the stop can take, each with its link.

change.description: The change to make. Leave it out for the list of changes this stop can take.

city.description: With add_stop: the place to add (its name or IATA city code), from the list add_stop gives without it.

link.description: A FareDice trip link, as find_trips returns it (https://faredice.com/trip?l=... or /sea/trip?l=...).

stop.description: Which stop to change: 1 is where the first flight lands, 2 the next, and so on.

name: edit_trip
title: Change a FareDice trip's nights or places
